lines.zh: 我慢慢走过草甸，身上泛着金光。
lines.en: I cross the meadow slowly, gold light on my hide.

lines.zh: 我的蹄子踩进草里，很深。
lines.en: My hooves sink deep into the grass.
I lower my head to graze as I walk.
I flick my tail at the flies.
I walk along the truffle wood.
I am unhurried; I do not rush.
A sheen lies on my horns.
I go around a cranberry patch.
I have flattened a small patch of grass.
I cross the meadow with gold on my hide.
I lift my head, then let it fall.
I amble along.
I move slowly along the stream.
I walk with no particular purpose.
I stop to chew my cud.

lines.zh: 我拖着一身金光穿过去。
lines.en: I cross with gold light trailing off me.
I stand with gold light moving over me.
I lift my tail, then lower it.
I am chewing yesterday's grass.
I draw one long breath.

lines.zh: 我闻到松露的味道从土里冒上来。
lines.en: I smell truffles rising from the soil.

lines.zh: 我身上有一点很香的味道。
lines.en: There is something very fragrant about me.
I turn my head toward the field edge.
My eyes are calm.
I flick an ear.
There is no one in the meadow.
I chew the grass and slowly ruminate.
Now and then I shine.
I raise my eyes slowly to you.
The light on you is different.
The tip of my horn angles toward you.

lines.zh: 我闻到你口袋里苹果的味道。
lines.en: I smell apples in your pocket.
My hooves shuffle forward.
I have no horns meant for you.
You are standing quite far off.
I looked at you for a good while.
The sun makes me shine.
You may come a little closer.

lines.zh: 我腿一软，往后退了半步。
lines.en: My legs give, and I back half a step.
The pain made me lower my head.

lines.zh: 我低低一声，震得草叶响。
lines.en: One low bellow from me, and the grass shivers.
I backed off to the field edge.
The light on me has dimmed.
I look back at the calf.
My breath comes out rough.
I square my body up again.
Blood drips down into the grass.
I dare not come closer.
Is that the smell of apples?
That sweetness pulls my legs forward.
That smells wonderful.
I stretch my neck to sniff.
It went down in one bite.
Is there more in the basket?
Open your palm out.
Sweet things are what I love.
I chew very carefully.
This is not an ordinary apple.
You touch me and I shift.
I am heavy; I will not be pushed.
Your nudge makes me step sideways.
That landed on my thick hide.

lines.zh: 我往草地那边让了半步。
lines.en: I give half a step toward the grass.
My glow flickers, then I hold my ground.
I set all four hooves again.
Do not press against me.
A ring of grass is already down.
I have gone back to grazing.
Only in this season do I think of it.
I am always gentle with it.

lines.zh: 我们的角，几乎碰到一起。
lines.en: Our horns almost touch.
There is only us in the meadow.
I nuzzle its neck.
The grass sways at our feet.
Our bodies press together.
The calf will be a fine one.
I nuzzle the side of its neck.

lines.zh: 我和它，守着一片蔓越莓田。
lines.en: It and I keep one cranberry field.
I lower my head and pick it up.
This one I can chew.
This one I cannot swallow.
I chew; it is sweet.

lines.zh: 我用舌头卷了两下才收好。
lines.en: Two flicks of my tongue and it is stowed.
My teeth cannot wear this one down.
I nudged it with my nose.
I will keep this to chew slowly.
I go back to rooting the grass.
It fell from my mouth.

lines.zh: 那边的草在动，我看见了。
lines.en: The grass over there moves; I see it.

lines.zh: 那声响让我竖起了耳朵。
lines.en: That sound makes my ears stand up.
To get past, you come through me.

lines.zh: 金苹果的甜味里，我压低了角。
lines.en: In the sweetness of the apple, I lower my horns.
I turn my body slowly.
I gave a deep low bellow.
My glow dims; I know you have come.
I start walking that way.
I press that way.
It is best you step back.
I scrape the turf bare and plant myself.
I have not decided whether to charge.
I walk toward it step by step.
I am not fast, but I am heavy.
I stay in front of the calf.
My horns point that way.
No rush; I inch forward.
The calf is behind me.
Each step lands solid.

lines.zh: 我尾巴打在地上，扬起土。
lines.en: My tail strikes the ground and kicks up dust.

lines.zh: 我的蹄印，一直朝你延伸。
lines.en: My hoofprints run straight at you.

lines.zh: 再近一步，我的角就不客气。
lines.en: One more step and my horns will answer.

lines.zh: 我呼吸重了，蹄子在刨地。
lines.en: My breath thickens and my hooves paw the dirt.
I stare at you and stop grazing.

lines.zh: 我把肩和角一起压过去。
lines.en: I drive my shoulder and horns in together.

lines.zh: 我的角只是警告，不是杀招。
lines.en: My horns are a warning, not a killing blow.
I stamp a hoof down.

lines.zh: 这一下顶得我脖子发酸。
lines.en: That butt left my neck aching.
I butt and draw back.
I shove it off my grass.
That butt went wide.
I lowered my head again.
My gold light flashes.
I hold position and attack no further.
A spot of gold light appears in the meadow.

lines.zh: 我的金光从草丛里透出来。
lines.en: My golden glow shows through the grass.
I come out from the truffle wood.
Grass presses down under my hooves.

lines.zh: 我身上暖得像晒过太阳。
lines.en: I am warm as sun-baked stone.
I lift myself out of the golden grass.
The grass here is good.

lines.zh: 我在蔓越莓田边上站住。
lines.en: I stop at the edge of the cranberry field.
The light shifts on my back.
I stand very quietly.

lines.zh: 火烧到我的毛，我冲向水边。
lines.en: Fire catches my coat; I charge for the water.

lines.zh: 我摔在草地上，腿折了一下。
lines.en: I land on the grass and my leg folds.

lines.zh: 水淹没我，我拼命往上顶。
lines.en: Water covers me; I heave upward.
The blast flips me into the grass.

lines.zh: 有东西扎进我腿侧的皮。
lines.en: Something pierced the hide of my flank.

lines.zh: 一股力和我身上的光撞在一起。
lines.en: Some force meets the light in me.
Too little grass; my legs are weak.

lines.zh: 雷落在我背上，我的金光全灭了。
lines.en: Lightning struck my back and all my gold went out.

lines.zh: 脚下没有草，我抓不住任何东西。
lines.en: There is no grass and nothing to grip.
